arxiv-2102-02570.title: Classical simulation and theory of quantum annealing in a thermal environment
arxiv-2102-02570.creator: Hiroki Oshiyama, Sei Suzuki, Naokazu Shibata
arxiv-2102-02570.description: Abstract We study quantum annealing in the quantum Ising model coupled to a thermal environment. When the speed of quantum annealing is sufficiently slow, the system evolves following the instantaneous thermal equilibrium. This quasistatic and isothermal evolution, however, fails near the end of annealing because the relaxation time grows infinitely, therefore yielding excess energy from the thermal equilibrium.

arxiv-2107-11373.title: Cardinality-constrained structured data-fitting problems Zhenan Fan and Huang Fang contributed equally to this paper.
arxiv-2107-11373.creator: \firstname Zhenan \lastname Fan, \firstname Huang \lastname Fang, \firstname Michael \middlename P. \lastname Friedlander
arxiv-2107-11373.description: Abstract A memory-efficient framework is described for the cardinality-constrained structured data-fitting problem. Dual-based atom-identification rules are proposed that reveal the structure of the optimal primal solution from near-optimal dual solutions. These rules allow for a simple and computationally cheap algorithm for translating any feasible dual solution to a primal solution that satisfies the cardinality constraint.

arxiv-2303-12433.title: Legendrian links and déjà vu moments Thanks: This work was partially supported by the SFB TRR 191 Symplectic Structures in Geometry, Algebra and Dynamics , funded by the DFG (Projektnummer 281071066 – TRR 191).
arxiv-2303-12433.creator: Stefan Nemirovski
arxiv-2303-12433.description: Abstract . A Legendrian link is called a déjà vu link if its components can be connected by a positive Legendrian isotopy but this isotopy cannot be embedded. This is the contact geometric analogue of a pair of events in a spacetime such that there are déjà vu moments on every future-directed timelike path between them.

arxiv-2310-13302.title: Towards the MICADO@ELT PSF-R with simulated and real data
arxiv-2310-13302.creator: Matteo Simioni, Carmelo Arcidiacono, Andrea Grazian, Marco Gullieuszik, Elisa Portaluri, Benedetta Vulcani, Roland Wagner, Anita Zanella
arxiv-2310-13302.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matteo Simioni, Carmelo Arcidiacono, Andrea Grazian, Marco Gullieuszik, Elisa Portaluri, Benedetta Vulcani, Roland Wagner, Anita Zanella. Observations close to the diffraction limit, with high Strehl ratios from Adaptive Optics (AO)-assisted instruments mounted on ground-based telescopes are a reality and will become even more widespread with the next generation instruments that equip 30 meter-class telescopes. This results in a growing interest in tools and methods to accurately reconstruct the observed Point Spread Function (PSF) of AO systems.

arxiv-2310-16024.title: Physics of excitons in layered BiI 3 . Effects of dimensionality and crystal anisotropy
arxiv-2310-16024.creator: Jorge Cervantes-Villanueva 1, Fulvio Paleari 2, Alberto García-Cristóbal 1, Davide Sangalli 3, Alejandro Molina-Sánchez 1
arxiv-2310-16024.description: Abstract We carry out a detailed theoretical study of the electronic and optical properties of bulk and monolayer bismuth triiodide (BiI 3 ), a layered metal halide, using the ab initio GW+BSE scheme with a full spinorial formulation. We discuss in detail the effects due to the change of dimensionality and the role of spin-orbit coupling.

arxiv-2405-10838.title: Superconducting spin valve effect in the Co/Pb/Co heterostructure with insulating interlayers
arxiv-2405-10838.creator: A. A. Kamashev, N. N. Garif’yanov, A. A. Validov, V. Kataev, A. S. Osin, Ya. V. Fominov, I. A. Garifullin
arxiv-2405-10838.description: Abstract We report the superconducting properties of the Co/Pb/Co heterostructures with thin insulating interlayers. The main specific feature of these structures is the intentional oxidation of both superconductor/ferromagnet (S/F) interfaces. We study variation of the critical temperature of our systems due to switching between parallel and antiparallel configurations of the magnetizations of the two magnetic layers.

arxiv-2408-11018.title: PIP-II linac Cryogenic Distribution System design challenges
arxiv-2408-11018.creator: T. Banaszkiewicz, M. Chorowski, P. Duda, M. Stanclik, Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, Wroclaw, Poland R. Dhuley, A. Martinez, W. Soyars, Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory, Batavia, USA
arxiv-2408-11018.description: Abstract The PIP-II linac Cryogenic Distribution System (CDS) is characterized by extremely small heat inflows and robust mechanical design. It consists of a Distribution Valve Box (DVB), Intermediate Transfer Line, Tunnel Transfer Line, comprising 25 Bayonet Cans, and ends with a Turnaround Can. Multiple helium streams, each characterized by distinct helium parameters, flow through each of these elements.

arxiv-2502-17705.title: Homophilic Effects on Economic Inequality: A Dynamic Network Agent-Based Model
arxiv-2502-17705.creator: Gustavo L. Kohlrausch, Thiago Dias, Sebastian Gonçalves
arxiv-2502-17705.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gustavo L. Kohlrausch, Thiago Dias, Sebastian Gonçalves. Wealth transactions are central to economic activity, and their particularities shape macroeconomic outcomes. We propose an agent-based model to investigate how homophily influences economic inequality. The model simulates wealth exchanges in a dynamic network composed of two groups, A A and B B , differentiated by a homophily parameter δ \delta , which increases intragroup connections within A A .

arxiv-2504-14342.title: Purcell-enhanced lifetime modulation of quantum emitters as a probe of local refractive index changes
arxiv-2504-14342.creator: Yevhenii M. Morozov, Anatoliy S. Lapchuk
arxiv-2504-14342.description: Abstract Quantum emitters embedded in photonic integrated circuit (PIC) cavities offer a powerful and scalable platform for label-free refractive index sensing at the nanoscale. We propose and theoretically analyze a sensing mechanism based on Purcell-enhanced modulation of the emitter’s spontaneous emission lifetime, enabling detection of refractive index changes via time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC).

pmc-11475673.title: The Cancer Patient Empowerment Program: A Comprehensive Approach to Reducing Psychological Distress in Cancer Survivors, with Insights from a Mixed-Model Analysis, Including Implications for Breast Cancer Patients
pmc-11475673.creator: Gabriela Ilie, Gregory Knapp, Ashley Davidson, Stephanie Snow, Hannah M Dahn, Cody MacDonald, Markos Tsirigotis, Robert David Harold Rutledge, Sebastiano Mercadante
pmc-11475673.description: Simple SummaryCancer patients frequently encounter significant emotional and psychological challenges that can adversely affect their overall well-being and treatment outcomes. pmc-11496201.description: While it is recognised that most, if not all, multicellular organisms harbour neoplastic processes within their bodies, the timing of when these undesirable cell proliferations are most likely to occur and progress throughout the organism's lifetime remains only partially documented.

pmc-11680200.creator: Yaning Lv, Ze Tong, Jiaqi Liu, Zhaoran Zhang, Chenchen Wang, Yan Zeng, Pingxuan Liu, Xin Zong, Guosheng Chen, Huanchun Chen, Chen Tan, Ulrich Desselberger

pmc-12538227.title: Tendon Tissue Engineering: Pathophysiological Mechanism and Bioengineering Therapy of Tendinopathy
pmc-12538227.creator: Bin Chen, Yingqi Zhao, Shizhen Guo, Chuyue Tang, Baoyun Xu, Mei Zhou, Qianbo Chen, Lin Ma, Jingtong Lyu, Lin Guo, Yunjiao Wang
pmc-12538227.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Tendinopathy afflicts many professional athletes and the elderly. However, due to the unique cellular and histological composition of tendons, healing is frequently unsatisfactory. The clinical physical therapy and surgical interventions often fail to meet patient expectations. In recent years, bioengineering technology has undergone rapid development, with a significant number of studies in the biological field focusing on bioengineering technology to explore emerging treatments for diseases. Therefore, bioengineering technology has the potential to become an important part of future tendon healing therapies.

pmc-13358280.title: Plasma proteomics predicts pathological complete response and reveals LIF as a potential mediator of resistance to neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy in resectable NSCLC
pmc-13358280.creator: Shoucheng Feng, Ziqing Feng, Songzuo Xie, Yuheng Zhou, Weizhen Sun, Nengqi Lin, Zhichao Lin, Qinglin Wang, Zerui Zhao, Yaobin Lin, Hao Long

Clinically scalable, minimally invasive biomarkers that predict response and point to actionable resistance mechanisms remain needed.
